TWO SPACIOUS THREE-BEDROOM APARTMENTS

We are delighted to present this character-filled residence occupying an elevated position in the Summerhill area of Bantry. Enjoying extensive views across the town and out over Bantry Bay, the property benefits from a very convenient location within walking distance of all local amenities, while retaining a quiet and private position.
Rich in old-world charm, the home retains many of its original features, including sash windows, which add greatly to its character and appeal. To the rear, a generous terraced garden rises behind the property, providing outdoor space from which to enjoy the spectacular views and surrounds.
Unusually, the property is currently arranged as two spacious three-bedroom apartments, one occupying the ground floor and the other the first floor. The ground floor apartment is accessed via the original front entrance and benefits from a sheltered walled garden, while the upper apartment has a separate entrance located on the side gable. An elevator to the rear of the property also provides convenient access to the first-floor accommodation.
The flexibility of the layout offers a wide range of possibilities for future use. Whether retained in its current configuration, adapted for multi-generational living, or a substantial family home, there is significant scope for a new owner to personalise and maximise the potential of this unique property.

Features:
Off street parking
Ground Floor: OFCH
1st Floor: Back boiler & Electric Heating
Elevator to access 1st Floor
Mains water & drainage

All information is provided in good faith and believed to be correct; however, it is not guaranteed and should be independently verified. No representations or warranties, express or implied, are made as to the accuracy, completeness, condition, or planning status of the property.
Interested parties should investigate independently as to the accuracy of all details, including measurements, boundaries, area, BER rating, and available services. In addition, all apparatus, fixtures, fittings or services should be thoroughly tested to assess their working condition.
Photographs and videos are for guidance purposes only and may show items (such as furniture) that are not included in the sale unless specifically agreed between the parties.
